reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires gate verdict kinds GateDecision:upstream-repair and GateDecision:terminal-reject; forward gate commands (workplace.runAuthorGate/runFinalGate) emit only {accepted, repair_required, human_required}. Two EK-9-frozen verdict kinds have no forward producer.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: adopt the plan-frozen gate-result universe {accept, repair, upstream repair, human wait, terminal reject} for both gate commands; terminal-reject feeds truthful-failure proofs; upstream-repair creates obligation:routeUpstreamRepair (re-typing forward F105's contribution-level upstream-defect routing into the gate verdict). Citation: PLAN:EK9-dimensions ('gate result: accept, repair, upstream repair, human wait, terminal reject').

reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires EffectReceipt kinds already-applied, retryable, policy-terminal; forward settleEffect outcomes are only {success, repair_required, human_required, unknown}.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: adopt the plan-frozen effect-result universe {success, already applied, retryable, unknown, human wait, policy terminal} for workplace.settleEffect. already-applied = idempotency-key replay (PLAN:EK3: duplicate command/idempotency keys cannot create a second fact or effect); retryable = bounded substrate retry with redrive; policy-terminal = alternative terminal path for failure proofs. Citations: PLAN:EK9-dimensions (effect result list), PLAN:EK4 (policy terminal in failure taxonomy), PLAN:EK3.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse evidence kind AcceptedCandidateAuthority (exact effect input; authority conservation) has no explicit forward producer command.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: AcceptedCandidateAuthority commits in the gate-accept transaction of workplace.runAuthorGate (accepted, no-effect path) / workplace.runFinalGate (accepted verdict) — the forward edges F066/F071 already carry the note 'authority commit isFinal'; it is consumed by workplace.settleEffect (F070) and workplace.recordFinalAcceptance. Citations: FWD:F066, FWD:F071 (notes), ADR053:authority (AcceptedCandidateAuthority is the exact effect input), ADR053:conservation.

reconciliation.difference: Forward TypedWait W7 (dependency readiness) with wake = predecessor obligation completion has no reverse node and no reverse discharge path; reverse models readiness only as a success-closure predicate (TerminalProof:node.success requires WorkItemDependency + predecessor evidence).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: TypedWait:readiness enters the universe as a lawful nonterminal wait (plan write-time progress invariant: 'a typed wait with a durable wake source'); wake = predecessor CellFinalAcceptance/EffectReceipt arrival (predecessor obligation completion); dead-predecessor conversion to unreachable settlement via obligation:markDependantsUnreachable. Citations: ADR097:decision (readiness is a predicate over exact predecessor final-acceptance/effect evidence — never a blocked->todo command), FWD:F052 (waitPolicyDetail), FWD:W7, PLAN:durable-handoff (nothing waits on a dead wake source).

reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires ProductVerificationEvidence / ProductVerificationFailure for TerminalProof:run.success / run.failure; forward factoryRun.recordRunTerminalProof binds only lifecycle terminal evidence.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: independent product verification (install/build/test/start, API/CLI/browser smoke) is required evidence of the run terminal proofs, produced by an independent verifier actor through public ingress (no new aggregate; evidence fact of FactoryRun). Citation: PLAN:EK12 exit ('Every success has a truthful terminal proof and independent product verification') and the R1-R3 verification requirement list; PLAN:EK11 (product verification commands and budgets in the qualification kit).

reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires ContextEnvelopeComplianceEvidence (every ActivityAttempt: pinned role digest + unbroken receipt sequence) for TerminalProof:run.success; forward has no producer.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: it is a settlement-time predicate over existing evidence kinds (PromptAssemblyReceipt:admitted/refused sequence + CanonicalRoleContractBinding/ProviderRoutePin pins), evaluated and recorded with the run proof — not a new mutable fact or second linearization point (no 'latest receipt' selection: PLAN:context-envelope 'The accountant never derives current authority by selecting a latest receipt'). Citation: PLAN:EK11-kit ('every ActivityAttempt to carry its pinned role-contract digest and an unbroken PromptAssemblyReceipt sequence').

reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires ForwardReverseReconciliationReceipt (idea/scope/unknown/terminal-claim forward-reverse typed equality) for TerminalProof:run.success; forward has no producer.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: produced by the settlement-time observed-graph comparison command (EK-6: generate forward and reverse observed graphs from committed events and evidence, then compare with the independently declared protocol graphs). Citations: PLAN:EK6 ('Generate forward and reverse observed graphs... compare them with the independently declared protocol graphs'), PLAN:EK12 ('Require idea/scope/unknown/terminal-claim forward/reverse reconciliation').

reconciliation.difference: Forward gaps G4 (documentation loop 13/23 demonstrated), G5 (Development pending tokens D2/D7/D8/D10), G9-in-part and G10-in-part (K4 crash-window demonstrations pending) are demonstration-debt gaps, not underspecified protocol.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (routing): these edges are lawful-declared in the universe; their causal demonstration is a blocking EK-9 corpus obligation under the declared-equals-demonstrated law — not a protocol decision and not a silent acceptance. Citation: PLAN:EK9 ('Maintain an independently declared WORKFLOW_OBLIGATION_UNIVERSE and require declared equals demonstrated'; 'Fail CI if a test... is deleted or de-hosted').

reconciliation.difference: Forward gap G6 (prompt/context admission semantics depth is not derivable from the transition graph).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (assignment): the plan already owns this elsewhere — exact overflow/repair/retry-charge semantics are frozen in the EK-1 admission specifications (prompt-budget-profile.schema.json) and implemented by WP-18; the universe carries only the admission boundary (activityAttempt.admitProviderRequest, obligation:providerSend, admitted/refused receipts, crash-redrive, typed uncertainty). Citation: PLAN:EK1 (Successor admission specifications), plan work-package table row WP-18.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse gap G7: settlement fan-in membership (workplaces-per-node, nodes-per-process, processes-per-stage, stages-per-lifecycle) not frozen in plan text; reverse stage-level edges pattern-inferred and reverse assumed plural processes per stage.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: membership frozen from the forward lane's own structure with corroborating census: workplaces-per-node = N (materializeCell fan-out per WorkItem/verification item, FWD:F050/F051); nodes-per-process = N per declared module flow (FWD:F106-F132); processes-per-stage = exactly 1 (stageRun.activate binds THE installed process module — FWD:F042; census stage family 'StageCommand(create|settle)... bind StageRun+ProcessRun'); stages-per-lifecycle = N per routing (FWD:F023/F025/F028). The stage fan-in quantifier is retained but degenerates to the single process. Citations: FWD:F042, FWD:F050, FWD:F051, CENSUS:stage, CENSUS:process.

reconciliation.difference: Forward carry-forward edges (redevelop F006, release continuation F011/F012, development continuation F013/F014 — accepted-prefix) have no reverse-graph counterpart: no terminal claim walks continuations.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: continuations are ingress-class — a continuation lifecycle begins from a capsule-hash-pinned input whose accepted prefix binds as InputEvidenceRefs/CapsuleIngressReceipt evidence (reverse already requires InputEvidenceRefs with note 'predecessor CellFinalAcceptance/EffectReceipt or CapsuleIngressReceipt refs'). No separate reverse closure exists because the continuation's own terminal proofs close over its own scope. Citations: REV:InputEvidenceRefs (note), FWD:F005/F006/F011-F014, FWD:G9.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse types EffectReceipt:human-wait as requiring TypedWait:external-availability; forward types the effect human_required outcome as a human-input wait discharged by the operator human-response command (F076 enterHumanWait; F088 resumeEffect after human resolution).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: the forward typing is adopted — EffectReceipt:human-wait creates TypedWait:human-input with wake = workplace.resolveHumanResponse -> obligation:resumeEffect. The reverse edge is re-typed accordingly (derivation slip: the effect wait is a human wait, not a substrate-availability wait; substrate availability is the separate W4/probe path). Citations: FWD:F076, FWD:F088, predecessor e70 (docs/factory-map/forward-graph.v1.json#e70), PLAN:EK9-dimensions (human wait is its own effect result).

reconciliation.difference: Forward has TWO producers of EffectReceipt-class facts: workplace.settleEffect and nodeRun.recordProviderOutcome ('with idempotent EffectReceipt'); reverse and census declare EffectReceipt a Workplace-owned fact with one writer (RunEffect).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (single-writer re-typing): workplace.settleEffect is the sole EffectReceipt writer; nodeRun.recordProviderOutcome is re-typed as the NodeRun command that submits external-provider outcome evidence into the owning Workplace effect transaction (obligation chain publishRelease/observeRelease -> settleEffect). One fact, one owner, one linearization point. Citations: PLAN:target-model (EffectReceipt row), ADR053:chain (effects are post-acceptance Workplace chain), CENSUS:effect ('RunEffect(authority: AcceptedCandidateAuthority, idempotencyKey)'), PLAN:one-authority.

reconciliation.difference: Forward processRun.settle issues a ProcessOutcomeCertificate consumed by stageRun.recordLocalOutcome; the reverse graph has no such node (process success closes over node successes + obligation receipts).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: ProcessOutcomeCertificate IS the TerminalProof:process.success evidence committed in the settle transaction ('settle is a certificate, not a manifest capability'); it is also the route-lifecycle obligation evidence for the stage outcome. Citations: FWD:F045 (note), FWD:F046, CENSUS:process ('certificate becomes the proof evidence').

reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires CheckPlan (immutable manifest value) as gate-decision evidence; forward declares CheckPlans out of transition scope (workshop semantic content).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (convention): CheckPlan instances are InstalledWorkshopManifest content — the forward input node in.manifest is the binding source; gates reference them as exact evidence refs. No kernel transition kind originates from a workshop. Citations: FWD:outOfScope[2] ('their contracts appear as evidenceRefs on the edges they guard'), REV:CheckPlan, PLAN:target-model (GateDecision row: 'immutable decision over one exact CandidateSet and CheckPlan').

reconciliation.difference: Reverse declares a WorkflowEvent co-requisite on every edge (not exploded into separate edges); forward materializes one emits-event per command.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (convention): reconcile by convention, not by edge duplication — every command's WorkflowEvent is a co-requisite fact of the same transaction (universe records it in commands[].emitsEvents). Citation: REV:conventions.eventCoRequisite + reverse reconciliation note ('reconcile by convention, not by adding 112 edges'), PLAN:durable-handoff.

reconciliation.difference: Forward carries 27 module-flow edges (discovery/formalization/development/delivery/documentation node advances); the reverse graph contains no module-flow nodes (workshop semantics are not protocol transitions).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (convention): module flows are installed process-module manifest content; the typed protocol edge is obligation:advanceProcessFlow (processRun.recordNodeTerminal -> enterNode|settle) — one obligation kind, per-module data carried as flow descriptors, no workshop-name kernel branch. Citations: FWD grammar (flow-qualified edges), PLAN:EK8 ('Keep module/package identity in installed manifests, never in kernel conditionals'), FWD:outOfScope[2].

reconciliation.difference: Forward produces RecoveryIssue (immutable exact repair feedback) inside enterRepairWait/settleEffect(repair); the reverse repair closure stops at 'GateDecision:repair requires WorkIntent' and names no feedback evidence kind.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: RecoveryIssue enters the evidence registry as the repair-loop feedback fact consumed by obligation:requeueRepair (the repair WorkIntent binds the exact RecoveryIssue refs). Citations: FWD:F067/F075/F078, tests/factory-contract/transition-conformance-scenarios.mjs#repair-loop (universal repair-loop theorem: candidate -> changes_requested -> exact feedback -> candidate -> approved).

reconciliation.difference: Reverse declares a distinct TerminalProof:cell.success; forward's proof inventory has only workplace-scope P1 with the cell-level completion recorded as CellFinalAcceptance (no separate proof command).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED: TerminalProof:cell.success commits in the workplace.recordFinalAcceptance transaction — 'cell success is exactly the recorded final acceptance; an empty queue is never a proof'. Citations: REV:TerminalProof:cell.success (edge note), FWD:workplace.recordFinalAcceptance, PLAN:target-model (CellFinalAcceptance row).

reconciliation.difference: Reverse edge 'GateDecision:accepted requires CandidateSet:reviewer' reads as if every accepted gate needs a reviewer presentation; forward author gates decide over author presentations with no reviewer.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: RESOLVED (convention): reverse gate-closure edges are role-conditioned — author-phase gates require CandidateSet:author; final gates over the reviewer verdict set require CandidateSet:reviewer (which binds its subject author CandidateSet). Citations: REV:GateDecision:accepted edges (notes 'reviewer-role gates decide over the reviewer CandidateSet presentation'), FWD:F064/F069, R20 recorded in universe commands.

reconciliation.difference: Forward G1 (physical command/event/obligation names are proposals) + forward G8 (settle node placement) + reverse conventions.physicalNames: the physical vocabulary of the whole universe is unfrozen.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D1 (coordinator freeze): adopt the vocabulary of this transition-universe.json as the frozen physical names — including settle = processRun.settle (forward G8: 'naming freeze only, no semantic gap') — or name specific renames before WP-05. RECOMMENDED: adopt as-is; every identifier here is already used consistently by both reconciled lanes. Blocks: WP-05, WP-16 name pinning.

reconciliation.difference: Forward produces EffectReceipt:repair_required (settleEffect repair outcome; git-integration conflict canonical case, F075) but the plan-frozen effect-result universe (EK-9) has no repair kind and neither does the reverse closure.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D2: EITHER (a) extend the frozen effect-result vocabulary with 'repair' (7 kinds) — the universal repair-loop theorem and predecessor obligation-contracts (effect.git-integration) demonstrate effect-level repair and the repair WorkIntent binds the exact RecoveryIssue — OR (b) re-type predecessor effect-repair as gate-level repair only (effect settles retryable/unknown; repair verdicts decided solely by gates), deleting EffectReceipt:repair. RECOMMENDED: (a). Blocks: effect contract freeze, EK-9 scenario dimensions.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse cancellation closures require TypedWaitDisposition (all waits discharged/cancelled) and ActivityAttempt:cancelled (every in-flight lease dispositioned); forward has no producer for either, and reverse G6 admits the propagation shape is not frozen (per-member proofs vs one proof naming member dispositions).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D3: EITHER (a) cancellation proofs exist at {lifecycle, run} scope and NAME member dispositions (per-scope member list + per-attempt lease disposition receipts committed by a new activityAttempt.cancel command and a TypedWaitDisposition evidence committed with the cancellation settlement) — OR (b) per-scope cancellation proofs at all 7 scopes, each requiring OperatorStopCommand + TypedWaitDisposition locally. RECOMMENDED: (a) — fewer proof kinds, same conservation (dispositions are named evidence, not separate proofs). Blocks: EK-4 wait/cancel semantics, EK-6 settlement.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse requires ExecutableVerifierResult (every terminal lifecycle claim has an owned construction surface and an executable verifier — reverse G8: receipt kind and owner not frozen); forward has no verifier command at all.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D4: EITHER (a) LifecycleRun-owned command lifecycleRun.verifyTerminalClaims executing installed verifier contracts (verifier definitions are InstalledWorkshopManifest CheckPlan-class content; receipt ExecutableVerifierResult owned by LifecycleRun) — OR (b) a certifier-semantic-profile Workplace per lifecycle running verifiers through the accepted-material chain (receipt via CellFinalAcceptance). RECOMMENDED: (a) — no new Workplace lifecycle, verifier semantics stay workshop-manifest content. Blocks: lifecycle.success closure, EK-6 terminal-claim equality.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse G3: discharge evidence kinds for TypedWait:external-availability and TypedWait:policy-quota are unnamed (human-input discharge is clearly a typed command).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D5: EITHER (a) discharge = obligation completion receipts of the forward-named durable wake sources (substrate re-probe obligation for external-availability; backoff-deadline obligation + policy re-evaluation for policy/quota; operator resume for operator-stop) — OR (b) dedicated external event receipt kinds (ExternalAvailabilityEventReceipt, QuotaReleaseReceipt) as new evidence kinds. RECOMMENDED: (a) — no new evidence kinds; wake sources are already durable obligations. Blocks: EK-4 typed-wait implementation.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse G1: what proves 'no lawful repair transition remains' for truthful-failure proofs (cell/workplace) is unnamed; the reverse closure stops at the rejecting GateDecision:terminal-reject / EffectReceipt:policy-terminal.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D6: EITHER (a) RepairTerminalityEvidence = the immutable repair-epoch ledger (attempt/epoch counters vs frozen caps: total attempt cap, diagnosis-repeat, convergence ceiling) or scope-refusal receipt, committed by workplace.rolloverRepairEpoch / widenAuthorityScope in the failure transaction — OR (b) a dedicated gate-emitted terminality predicate fact. RECOMMENDED: (a) — forward F081/F084 already name exactly these conditions with predecessor evidence (recovery:retry-exhaustion-terminal). Blocks: truthful-failure proof closure, EK-6 settlement.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse claims unreachable proofs at all 7 scopes (process/stage/lifecycle/run edges are predecessor-instance pattern references; reverse G2 admits run-scope triggers are not enumerated); forward demonstrates unreachable only at workplace/cell/node scope (F092 -> nodeRun.settleUnreachable) — dependency edges live on the WorkItem graph.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D7: EITHER (a) freeze the unreachable scope set as {cell, workplace, node} (the WorkItemDependency-graph scopes); process/stage/lifecycle failures settle as truthful failure (already in the universe) and TerminalProof:run.unreachable is deleted with TypedRefusalReceipt remaining pre-run (ingress refusal, no run exists) — OR (b) keep all 7 scopes and enumerate the in-run run-scope unreachable triggers. RECOMMENDED: (a) — nothing in the model depends on process/stage/lifecycle predecessors (flow is declared, stages sequential, continuations created after parent terminal). Blocks: settlement vocabulary, EK-6.

reconciliation.difference: Forward G2: obligation:replayCaptureSweep (run-scope replay-capsule certification) is emitted by lifecycleRun.issueTerminalProof toward workplace.settleEffect, but which owner settles the run-scope capsule is not derivable (FactoryRun settlement effect vs a certification Workplace).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D8: EITHER (a) a certification Workplace materialized at run settlement (the sweep is an ordinary effect of that Workplace; EffectReceipt stays Workplace-written, one writer) — OR (b) a FactoryRun-owned settleRunEffect command (second effect writer at run scope, weakening the single-writer law). RECOMMENDED: (a). Blocks: effect contract freeze, replay-capture demonstration token.

reconciliation.difference: Forward G3: watchdog/supervisor target ownership — proposed aggregate command factoryRun.observeWatchdog (observe-only) vs a pure observer process with no aggregate.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D9: EITHER (a) factoryRun.observeWatchdog as adopted here (durable WatchdogObservation evidence + typed obligations watchdogRestart/watchdogBudgetExhausted, all observe/command-only; never SQL repair) — OR (b) a stateless observer issuing typed commands through public ingress with evidence as WorkflowEvents only (no aggregate command, no durable observation rows). RECOMMENDED: (a) — watchdog findings need a durable owner for restart evidence; the command is already observe-only per PLAN:EK4. Blocks: EK-4 driver/watchdog tests.

reconciliation.difference: Forward G7: the exact command that opens an owned obligation per Discovery unknown (currently folded into workItem.planGraph) is unfrozen.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D10: EITHER (a) workItem.planGraph clause creating the DiscoveryUnknownObligation planning fact plus obligation:openUnknownObligation (runnable when the owning work runs) — OR (b) a separate ingress-time command at capsule import opening unknown obligations before planning. RECOMMENDED: (a) — unknowns cannot disappear at a workshop boundary and planning is where owners are assigned (PLAN:idea-conservation). Blocks: planning contract, EK-6.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse G5: CellFinalAcceptance required field set — embed acceptanceDigest and digest equality with the accepted WorkplaceProductionRevision, or only gate+effect refs.
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D11: EITHER (a) embed acceptanceDigest + materialDigest/semanticDigest equality with the accepted revision (digest-equality edges join the closure) — OR (b) exact gate+effect+obligation refs only (digest equality checked by tests, not carried by the fact). RECOMMENDED: (a) — makes the authority-conservation invariant (ADR053:conservation test 1) executable on the fact itself. Blocks: schema freeze (WP-06), CellFinalAcceptance contract.

reconciliation.difference: Reverse G4 + forward G10(demonstration part routed by R8): what receipt RESOLVES an EffectReceipt:unknown / send-uncertainty wait is unnamed (idempotency probe? external confirmation? human disposition?).
reconciliation.resolutionOrRequest: PROTOCOL DECISION D12: EITHER (a) operator human disposition via typed resolution command (discharge receipt = the command's evidence; matches forward W8 wake and PLAN:EK9 'human wait' effect result) — OR (b) automated idempotency-probe receipt (external check executed by the effect contract) — OR (c) both, with (b) as an effect-contract extension and (a) as the guaranteed fallback. RECOMMENDED: (a) now (smallest frozen surface), (c) later only if an effect contract needs probes. Blocks: EK-4 uncertainty semantics, K4-class fault demonstrations.
